# Francesco Memoli (akiidjk)

> Portfolio of Francesco Memoli, known online as akiidjk — software engineer and security researcher specializing in systems programming, web exploitation, reverse engineering, and CTF infrastructure. Co-founder of the CTF team ByteTheCookies, based in Salerno, Italy.

## Pages

- [Home](https://akiidjk.dev/): Hero intro, featured work, lab experiments, competition archive, about, and contact.
- [Projects](https://akiidjk.dev/projects): Full catalog of open-source projects and tools, including CookieFarm (attack-defense CTF framework) and Discord CTF Helper.
